newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL to release Q1 earnings on May 20.
newsitem.headline: MOL to release Q1 earnings on May 20.

text.p: Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt will release its first quarter earnings reports on Tuesday, May 20, a statement in the official bourse gazette said on Friday.

All other companies whose shares trade in the listed "A" category of the Budapest Stock Exchange -- and therefore are obliged to release earnings reports quarterly -- released their January-March figures by May 15.
MOL, the bourse's largest capitalised issue, has completed the second phase of its privatisation.

The international global offering of a 12.5 percent stake was six-times oversubscribed. A two percent stake on offer to each for Hungarian domestic investors and local institutional investors were three times and 44 times oversubscribed, respectively.
